_source: OurAirports (ourairports.com/data) — Public Domain. airports.csv, filtered to the scraplan collector bbox (lat 12–42N, lon 24–63.5E) + type in {large_airport, medium_airport} + scheduled_service=yes. icao = icao_code (fallback gps_code/ident); elevation_ft is MSL feet.
_note: Committed static gazetteer, loaded once in-process, NEVER fetched at runtime (mirrors mmsi_mid.json). Vicinity + elevation-relative landing detection (E4-pre): the altitude ceiling MUST be relative to elevation_ft (field elevation), not absolute.
